firstPlayerRule: Each player draws two tiles and adds their numbers. The player with the highest sum goes first.
officialTieBreak: If there is a tie, the tied players draw again.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give the starter the starting token, then return all drawn tiles to the bag.
